import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.transforms as mtransforms
import numpy as np
import json
import os

os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    raw = json.load(f)

top10 = raw['top10_daly_causes']['data']
income = raw['daly_by_income_group']['data']
global_totals = raw['global_category_totals']['data']

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Palatino", "Palatino Linotype", "Georgia", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 12,
    "figure.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "figure.dpi": 150,
    "axes.facecolor": "#fffff8",
    "axes.edgecolor": "#cccccc",
    "axes.linewidth": 0.5,
    "axes.labelcolor": "#666666",
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
    "axes.grid": False,
    "xtick.color": "#999999",
    "ytick.color": "#999999",
    "xtick.direction": "in",
    "ytick.direction": "in",
    "xtick.major.size": 3,
    "ytick.major.size": 3,
    "xtick.major.width": 0.5,
    "ytick.major.width": 0.5,
    "savefig.facecolor": "#fffff8",
})

COLORS = {
    "Communicable": "#4e79a7",
    "NCD": "#e15759",
    "Injury": "#f28e2b",
}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 13))

# ===== Title block =====
fig.text(0.08, 0.975,
    "The Global Disease Burden Shifted From Infections to Chronic Conditions, 1990–2024",
    fontsize=20, fontfamily='serif', color='#111', fontweight='bold')
fig.text(0.08, 0.950,
    "DALYs by cause rank and disease category, with income-group disparities  ·  Source: GBD-style modeled estimates (2024 projected)",
    fontsize=10.5, fontfamily='serif', color='#666')

# Color key — consistent across all panels
for i, (cat, col) in enumerate([("Communicable", COLORS["Communicable"]),
                                  ("NCD", COLORS["NCD"]),
                                  ("Injury", COLORS["Injury"])]):
    fig.text(0.08 + i * 0.095, 0.925, f"● {cat}",
             fontsize=10.5, color=col, fontfamily='serif', va='center')

# ===== PANEL 1: Slopegraph (top, full width) =====
ax1 = fig.add_axes([0.24, 0.48, 0.52, 0.40])

causes_1990 = {c['cause']: c for c in top10 if c['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {c['cause']: c for c in top10 if c['year'] == 2024}
shared = set(causes_1990.keys()) & set(causes_2024.keys())
dropped = set(causes_1990.keys()) - set(causes_2024.keys())
new_causes = set(causes_2024.keys()) - set(causes_1990.keys())

BELOW = 12.5

# Shared causes — solid prominent lines
for cause in sorted(shared, key=lambda c: causes_1990[c]['rank']):
    c90 = causes_1990[cause]
    c24 = causes_2024[cause]
    color = COLORS[c90['category']]
    rank_delta = abs(c24['rank'] - c90['rank'])
    lw = 2.8 if rank_delta >= 3 else 1.8
    zord = 3 if rank_delta >= 3 else 2

    ax1.plot([0, 1], [c90['rank'], c24['rank']], color=color, linewidth=lw,
             zorder=zord, solid_capstyle='round')
    ax1.plot(0, c90['rank'], 'o', color=color, markersize=6, zorder=zord + 1)
    ax1.plot(1, c24['rank'], 'o', color=color, markersize=6, zorder=zord + 1)

    # Left labels (1990)
    ax1.text(-0.04, c90['rank'], f"{cause}  ({c90['dalys_millions']:.0f}M)",
             ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9, color=color, fontfamily='serif')
    # Right labels (2024)
    ax1.text(1.04, c24['rank'], f"({c24['dalys_millions']:.0f}M)  {cause}",
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, color=color, fontfamily='serif')

# Dropped causes — fading dotted lines
for cause in sorted(dropped, key=lambda c: causes_1990[c]['rank']):
    c90 = causes_1990[cause]
    color = COLORS[c90['category']]
    ax1.plot([0, 1], [c90['rank'], BELOW], color=color, linewidth=1,
             alpha=0.30, linestyle=':', zorder=1)
    ax1.plot(0, c90['rank'], 'o', color=color, markersize=4, alpha=0.45, zorder=2)
    ax1.text(-0.04, c90['rank'], f"{cause}  ({c90['dalys_millions']:.0f}M)",
             ha='right', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color=color, alpha=0.50, fontfamily='serif')

# New causes — fading dotted lines
for cause in sorted(new_causes, key=lambda c: causes_2024[c]['rank']):
    c24 = causes_2024[cause]
    color = COLORS[c24['category']]
    ax1.plot([0, 1], [BELOW, c24['rank']], color=color, linewidth=1,
             alpha=0.30, linestyle=':', zorder=1)
    ax1.plot(1, c24['rank'], 'o', color=color, markersize=4, alpha=0.45, zorder=2)
    ax1.text(1.04, c24['rank'], f"({c24['dalys_millions']:.0f}M)  {cause}",
             ha='left', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color=color, alpha=0.50, fontfamily='serif')

# Top-10 boundary
ax1.axhline(y=10.5, color='#ccc', linewidth=0.5, linestyle=':', zorder=0)
ax1.text(0.5, 11.3, "Exited / entered top 10", ha='center', va='center',
         fontsize=7, color='#aaa', fontfamily='serif', fontstyle='italic')

# Key annotations
ax1.annotate("Ischemic heart disease\nnearly doubled → #1",
             xy=(1, 1), xytext=(0.52, 2.3),
             fontsize=8, fontfamily='serif', color='#e15759', fontstyle='italic',
             ha='center', va='bottom',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#e15759', lw=0.6,
                             connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.15'))

ax1.annotate("Lower respiratory infections\nfell 56% from #1 → #6",
             xy=(1, 6), xytext=(0.48, 8.0),
             fontsize=8, fontfamily='serif', color='#4e79a7', fontstyle='italic',
             ha='center', va='bottom',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#4e79a7', lw=0.6,
                             connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.15'))

# Format slopegraph
ax1.set_xlim(-0.42, 1.42)
ax1.set_ylim(BELOW + 0.5, 0.3)
ax1.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=16, fontfamily='serif', color='#111')
ax1.set_yticks([])
for spine in ax1.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)
ax1.tick_params(left=False, bottom=False, top=False, right=False)

# Subtle rank numbers near each column
for r in range(1, 11):
    ax1.text(-0.015, r, str(r), ha='right', va='center', fontsize=5.5, color='#ccc', fontfamily='serif')
    ax1.text(1.015, r, str(r), ha='left', va='center', fontsize=5.5, color='#ccc', fontfamily='serif')

# Panel title
ax1.text(0.5, 1.07, "NCDs Displaced Infections as the Leading Causes of DALYs",
         transform=ax1.transAxes, fontsize=14, fontfamily='serif', color='#111',
         ha='center', fontweight='bold')

# ===== PANEL 2: Income Group Composition (bottom left) =====
ax2 = fig.add_axes([0.10, 0.06, 0.44, 0.33])

income_labels = ['Low\nincome', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High\nincome']
income_keys = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
bar_height = 0.28
y_pos = np.arange(4)

cat_fields = [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]

for i, year in enumerate([1990, 2024]):
    for j, ig in enumerate(income_keys):
        row = [r for r in income if r['year'] == year and r['income_group'] == ig][0]
        offset = -bar_height / 2 - 0.04 if year == 1990 else bar_height / 2 + 0.04
        alpha = 0.40 if year == 1990 else 0.90
        left = 0
        for cat, field in cat_fields:
            val = row[field]
            ax2.barh(j + offset, val, left=left, height=bar_height,
                     color=COLORS[cat], alpha=alpha, edgecolor='none')
            if val > 9:
                txt_c = 'white' if alpha > 0.5 else COLORS[cat]
                fw = 'bold' if alpha > 0.5 else 'normal'
                ax2.text(left + val / 2, j + offset, f"{val:.0f}%",
                         ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
                         color=txt_c, fontfamily='serif', fontweight=fw)
            left += val

# Year labels using blended transform (axes-x, data-y)
trans2 = mtransforms.blended_transform_factory(ax2.transAxes, ax2.transData)
for j in range(4):
    ax2.text(-0.04, y_pos[j] - bar_height / 2 - 0.04, "1990",
             transform=trans2, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
             color='#aaa', fontfamily='serif')
    ax2.text(-0.04, y_pos[j] + bar_height / 2 + 0.04, "2024",
             transform=trans2, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
             color='#555', fontfamily='serif')

ax2.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax2.set_yticklabels(income_labels, fontsize=9.5, fontfamily='serif')
ax2.set_xlabel('Share of total DALYs (%)', fontsize=10, color='#666', fontfamily='serif')
ax2.set_xlim(0, 105)
ax2.set_xticks([0, 25, 50, 75, 100])
ax2.set_xticklabels(['0', '25', '50', '75', '100%'], fontsize=9, color='#999')

# Range-frame
ax2.spines['left'].set_bounds(-0.5, 3.5)
ax2.spines['bottom'].set_bounds(0, 100)
ax2.tick_params(left=False)

# Highlight key disparity
ax2.annotate("71% communicable\nin 1990 → 53% in 2024",
             xy=(53, 3.65), xytext=(68, 3.85),
             fontsize=7, fontfamily='serif', color='#4e79a7', fontstyle='italic',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#4e79a7', lw=0.5))

ax2.set_title("Low-Income Countries Retain the Highest Communicable Share",
              fontsize=13, fontfamily='serif', color='#111', pad=10,
              fontweight='normal', loc='left')

# ===== PANEL 3: Global Category Totals (bottom right) =====
ax3 = fig.add_axes([0.64, 0.06, 0.30, 0.33])

cats = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']
y_pos3 = np.arange(3)

for i, year in enumerate([1990, 2024]):
    for j, cat in enumerate(cats):
        row = [r for r in global_totals if r['year'] == year and r['category'] == cat][0]
        offset = -bar_height / 2 - 0.04 if year == 1990 else bar_height / 2 + 0.04
        alpha = 0.40 if year == 1990 else 0.90
        ax3.barh(j + offset, row['dalys_millions'], height=bar_height,
                 color=COLORS[cat], alpha=alpha, edgecolor='none')
        val_str = f"{row['dalys_millions']:.0f}M"
        ax3.text(row['dalys_millions'] + 18, j + offset, val_str,
                 va='center', fontsize=9, color='#555' if year == 2024 else '#aaa',
                 fontfamily='serif')

# Year labels
trans3 = mtransforms.blended_transform_factory(ax3.transAxes, ax3.transData)
for j in range(3):
    ax3.text(-0.04, y_pos3[j] - bar_height / 2 - 0.04, "1990",
             transform=trans3, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
             color='#aaa', fontfamily='serif')
    ax3.text(-0.04, y_pos3[j] + bar_height / 2 + 0.04, "2024",
             transform=trans3, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
             color='#555', fontfamily='serif')

# Percentage change labels
for j, cat in enumerate(cats):
    r90 = [r for r in global_totals if r['year'] == 1990 and r['category'] == cat][0]
    r24 = [r for r in global_totals if r['year'] == 2024 and r['category'] == cat][0]

ax3.set_yticklabels(cats, fontsize=11, fontfamily='serif')

ax3.spines['bottom'].set_bounds(0, 1500)
ax3.tick_params(left=False)

ax3.set_title("NCD Burden Nearly Doubled Globally",
